title: Evaluation-defined scalar Hom maps respect coefficient towers
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a site small in the module universe [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], and let $R\xrightarrow{a}S\xrightarrow{b}V$ be homomorphisms of sheaves of commutative rings. Use the ordinary unbounded derived module categories [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category], their closed tensor and internal-Hom structures [lem-sf-ringed-derived-closed-symmetric-monoidal], and derived scalar extensions $T_a,T_b,T_{ba}$ [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. Equip them with the canonical tensor comparisons $\mu_a:T_a(P\otimes^LQ)\cong T_aP\otimes^LT_aQ$ and balanced scalar associator $\alpha:T_bT_a\cong T_{ba}$, normalized on K-flat representatives. Assume the tensor-tower and identity equations of [lem-sfb-scalar-hom-tensor-coherence] for these comparisons. Write $H_R,H_S,H_V$ for the derived internal Homs [def-pur-derived-internal-hom], with evaluation in the convention $P\otimes H_R(P,Q)\to Q$ (using symmetry when needed). Define
$$c^a_{P,Q}:T_aH_R(P,Q)\longrightarrow H_S(T_aP,T_aQ)$$
to be the transpose of $T_aP\otimes T_aH_R(P,Q)\xrightarrow{\mu_a^{-1}}T_a(P\otimes H_R(P,Q))\xrightarrow{T_a(\operatorname{ev})}T_aQ$, and define $c^b,c^{ba}$ likewise. These maps are natural contravariantly in $P$ and covariantly in $Q$, and satisfy
$$H_V(\alpha_P^{-1},\alpha_Q)\,c^b_{T_aP,T_aQ}\,T_b(c^a_{P,Q})=c^{ba}_{P,Q}\,\alpha_{H_R(P,Q)}.$$
For the identity ring map, $c^{\mathrm{id}}$ is the identity under the scalar multiplication unitor. No flatness, finite-freeness, perfectness, boundedness or completeness assumption is required; the assertion concerns these maps, not their invertibility.
